explanation: The old name came from the upper Volta River. The new one blends words from Mooré and Dioula and is usually translated as 'land of upright people'.

claims.text: Burkina Faso was called Upper Volta until 1984.

The name Upper Volta came from the upper reaches of the Volta River.
The name Burkina Faso combines words from the Mooré and Dioula languages.
Burkina Faso is usually translated as 'land of upright people'.
